pinSize.$description: The pin button's box, centred on the row's type icon (cmp.iconButton.size); the row's height holds it.

iconBadgeSize.$description: A file's shared (person) or published (globe) badge on its icon's bottom-right corner (owner, 26 November; D-431). A file that's both has the globe above the person on the icon's end edge.

iconBadgeOverhang.$description: How far a badge sits past its icon's bottom edge (the globe past the top when both), so it covers less of the icon; it stays inside the end edge, clear of the name.

iconBadgeKnockout.$description: The ring cut out of the icon around a badge: a separation cue made of the surface itself (a mask), never a border or fill, so it holds on every row fill.

iconBadgeKeep.$description: The opaque part of the icon's knockout mask: only its alpha is read.

badge.$description: The shared and published badges' glyphs (owner, 26 November 22:57; D-431): the accent, at least 3:1 on every row and tab state (rest, hover, focus, the open note, selected, Opened files' active and inactive tabs) in every built-in theme and project accent, measured by file-badge-contrast.test.ts; the contrast guard warns when a custom theme's accent falls short. Highlight in forced colours (HighlightText on a selected row or the active tab).

badgePending.$description: D-436: the published (globe) badge while its Publish, Unpublish or update waits for GitHub Pages to serve it, with the commit mark's own-border pending arc around it.

badgeLive.$description: D-436: the globe badge for the moment its page is confirmed live (with the commit mark's success outline, held at least 200 ms), before it settles to the accent.

badgeFailed.$description: D-436: the globe badge when its page didn't go live (a failed Pages deploy or no answer in 10 minutes); the reason is in its tooltip and the recovery in the file's menu.

badgeRingStroke.$description: D-436: the badge's pending arc or outline stroke: the commit mark's own-border stroke (cmp.commitMark.borderStroke).

badgeRing.$description: D-436: how far the badge's pending arc or outline sits outside its glyph; the icon's knockout widens by this plus the arc's stroke while it shows, so the ring never touches the icon.
